intro: We do not publish a per-square-foot rate, because a number pulled off a chart is how people end up being quoted one price and billed another. Every AmeriStar Maids cleaning is priced from a free in-home estimate: we come out, look at the actual home, talk through what matters to you, and build a written plan and price around it. If we should skip the guest room, we will. If the playroom needs extra attention, we will say what that costs before we start. We are not the cheapest house cleaning service in the Back Mountain and we do not pretend to be — but the number you are given at the estimate is the number the work is based on.
notes: Refer a friend and receive $15–$25 off your next cleaning. E-gift cards are available in any amount toward recurring, one-time deep or general, and move-in/move-out cleaning; they expire one year from purchase and are non-refundable.
